_meta.indication: Temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines associated with corrugator and/or procerus muscle activity in adult patients.
_meta.receipt_date: November 25, 2019 (Submit Date November 24, 2019); resubmitted March 8, 2022 after CRL.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; subjects randomized 2:1 to DAXXIFY or placebo and treated on Day 0.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults 18 to 75 years with moderate or severe glabellar lines at maximum frown on the IGA-FWS and PFWS scales.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving a score of 0 or 1 (none or mild) and an improvement of at least two points from baseline to Week 4 concurrently on both the IGA-FWS and PFWS scales (2-point composite response).
pivotal_trials.result: Treatment success 148 (73.6%) DAXXIFY vs 0 (0%) placebo; estimate 74.2% (95% CI 68.2%, 80.2%); p<0.0001.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; subjects randomized 2:1 to DAXXIFY or placebo and treated on Day 0.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults 18 to 75 years with moderate or severe glabellar lines at maximum frown on the IGA-FWS and PFWS scales.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving a score of 0 or 1 (none or mild) and an improvement of at least two points from baseline to Week 4 concurrently on both the IGA-FWS and PFWS scales (2-point composite response).
pivotal_trials.result: Treatment success 151 (74.0%) DAXXIFY vs 1 (1.0%) placebo; estimate 72.9% (95% CI 66.6%, 79.1%); p<0.0001.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>=1%): headache (6%), eyelid ptosis (2%) and facial paresis (1%). In pooled SAKURA-1/2 (DAXXIFY N=406): headache 38 (9.4%) vs placebo 5 (2.5%); eyelid ptosis 9 (2.2%) vs 0; facial paresis 5 (1.2%) vs 0. Boxed warning for distant spread of toxin effect.
target_moa: DaxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm is an acetylcholine release inhibitor and neuromuscular blocking agent that blocks cholinergic transmission at the neuromuscular junction by cleaving SNAP25, inhibiting release of acetylcholine.
modality: Other (botulinum neurotoxin type A biologic; 150 kDa botulinum toxin protein)

boxed_warning.content: Distant spread of toxin effect: the effects of DAXXIFY and all botulinum toxin products may spread from the area of injection to produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects; swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have been reports of death.

rems.type: A REMS is not necessary to ensure the benefits outweigh the risks; the risks are those labeled for the entire class of botulinum toxins.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was convened; the review team determined the product presented no novel or complex issues requiring input.

summary.text: Standard (non-priority) BLA under section 351(a) of the PHS Act, received November 25, 2019, with no accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track, or orphan designations. The application received a Complete Response letter dated October 14, 2021 for manufacturing facility deficiencies; the Applicant resubmitted March 8, 2022 with no new clinical data, and efficacy/safety had been established in the first review cycle. No advisory committee was convened and no REMS was required.
